title: Opinionated acceptance oracle for prefetch-batching config apply and rollback
creator: Marina Alvarez
description: Build an automated acceptance oracle that determines whether a suggested prefetch/batching configuration (from the cost optimizer) can be safely applied to production or must be rolled back. The oracle combines lightweight automated checks over live traffic shadowing, a synthetic user-journey evaluation suite, and a small human audit path. Goals: 1) catch semantic regressions caused by increased caching/prefix-merging; 2) detect distributional token-level shifts that could indicate hallucination or repetitiveness; 3) provide clear numeric pass/fail criteria and an actionable rollback reason code for the rollout orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow-apply phase for 2 hours with 1% real-traffic shadowing and no user-visible responses altered
Semantic-similarity: average embedding cosine (reference vs candidate) >= 0.86 across reference_dialogs set
Response-stability: proportion of responses with structural/intent change <= 1.5% as measured by intent-classifier delta
Token-distribution KL between baseline and candidate <= 0.06 over top-10 token distributions
Human-audit pass rate >= 94% on stratified sample (50 API calls sampled across high-volume routes)
If any single automated metric breaches its threshold AND human-audit rate < 96%, trigger immediate reject/rollback
test_plan: 1) Run offline synthetic-journey harness against candidate config using the reference_dialogs corpus (2000 dialogs). 2) Run shadow-apply on a dedicated canary slice (1% traffic) for 2 hours. 3) Collect automated metrics and run intent-classifier diff + embedding similarity. 4) Launch 50-sample human audit simultaneous to shadow run. 5) If oracle passes, promote to progressive rollout: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with metric windows at each step.
rollout_policy: progressive (5%, 20%, 100%) with 30-minute stabilization windows. Automatic rollback if embedding similarity drops >0.03 relative to shadow baseline OR human-audit accept rate < 90% at any stage. Manual override requires PM + SRE approval and a follow-up postmortem.
implementation_notes:
- Will reuse existing shadow-proxy infra.
- Add a lightweight intent classifier trained on top-level customer intents (see confluence doc).
- Export per-route metrics to console: semantic_similarity, intent_delta_rate, kl_top10, human_pass_rate.
- Integrate with rollout service to attach rollback reason codes (SIM_DROP, INTENT_SHIFT, TOKEN_ANOMALY, HUMAN_FAIL).
